Canvas: Landscape 16:9 image, viewed from an elevated oblique angle as if looking down at a physical diorama map on a dark tabletop. Use a deep navy, charcoal, warm brass, and amber-light palette. Manhattan is centered and built as a dense miniature city with hundreds of extruded buildings, warm window lights, streetlight networks, bridges, docks, and dark reflective water. The tallest illuminated focal tower is the Empire State Building near the center, with a bright warm glow around Midtown. The southern tip includes a tall One World Trade Center tower. A long dark rectangle labeled Central Park sits in upper Manhattan. Surrounding flat map areas show New Jersey to the left, Queens to the right, and Brooklyn at lower right, with street grids drawn as thin golden lines.

Top title block: In the upper-left corner, add a boxed archive label reading exactly “NEW YORK CITY” with the subtitle “NOCTURNAL URBAN ARCHIVE” and a small archive code line “NYC-NAM-2024-001.” Add tiny header text along the top edge such as “LANDSCAPE ARCHIVE MODEL / 地景档案模型,” column letters across the top, and a small study label at the upper-right reading “EAST RIVER CORRIDOR STUDY” and “EDITION 01.”

Callouts and labels: Include exactly 11 named map labels/callout boxes: 1) “NEW JERSEY / HUDSON COUNTY,” 2) “HUDSON RIVER,” 3) “ONE WORLD TRADE CENTER / 1,776 ft / 541 m,” 4) “TIMES SQUARE / THEATER DISTRICT,” 5) “EMPIRE STATE BUILDING / 1,454 ft / 443 m,” 6) “CENTRAL PARK,” 7) “CHRYSLER BUILDING / 1,046 ft / 319 m,” 8) “EAST RIVER,” 9) “BROOKLYN BRIDGE / 1,595 ft / 486 m,” 10) “QUEENS / LONG ISLAND CITY,” 11) “BROOKLYN / DOWNTOWN BROOKLYN.” Use thin leader lines connecting callout boxes to landmarks.

Bottom information panels: Add exactly 4 technical panels along the bottom edge: 1) a legend panel with 6 symbol entries labeled “PRIMARY ROAD,” “SECONDARY ROAD,” “RAIL LINE,” “WATER BODY,” “PARK / GREEN SPACE,” and “MAJOR LANDMARK / BUILDING FOOTPRINT”; 2) a north arrow panel showing true north and grid north; 3) a scale panel labeled “SCALE 1:25,000” with imperial and metric scale bars; 4) an archive notes panel with small text including “ARCHIVE NOTES,” “This model represents a nocturnal capture of New York City urban form, infrastructure, and landmark illumination,” plus boxes for “ARCHIVE CODE NYC-NAM-2024-001,” “MODEL NO. 001,” and “SHEET NO. 01 / 01.”

The city should feel like a carefully directed miniature urban world, not a flat map.

prompt_en:
Create a Y2K futurist Windows desktop remix of Van Gogh’s The Starry Night as a glowing cyberpunk operating-system screenshot. The canvas is a 4:3 desktop wallpaper in deep ultramarine, neon violet, electric blue, cyan, and gold, with painterly impasto brush strokes forming huge swirling star vortices across the sky. Preserve the Starry Night composition: a tall black cypress-like spire in the lower left foreground, rolling dark hills, a glowing village transformed into a futuristic city, and a river or bay reflecting purple-blue neon lights. Add transparent glassmorphism Windows-2000/XP style UI overlays with violet chrome, bloom, scanline shimmer, pixel fonts, and small title-bar buttons.

Desktop layout: a vertical translucent sidebar on the far left with exactly 8 desktop icons, from top to bottom labeled: “my pc”, “internet”, “e-mail”, “msn”, “music”, “pictures”, “shop”, “explore”. At the very top left place a window title bar labeled “Starry_Night.vin” with menu items “file”, “edit”, “view”, “tools”, “help”. Along the bottom place a glowing purple taskbar with a rounded “start” button on the left and a system tray on the right showing “02:37 AM”; include a recycle bin icon and label “recycle bin” near the bottom right.

Add exactly 3 floating windows on the right side. Window 1, top right: a music player titled “now playing”, with a small square album thumbnail, track text “vincent’s dream” and “sleepy gogh”, five empty star-rating outlines, timestamp “01:37 / 04:28”, a progress bar, and previous / pause / next controls. Window 2, mid-right: an info panel titled “about: painting.exe”, headed “THE STARRY NIGHT”, listing “vincent van gogh”, “1889”, “oil on canvas”, “remixed in: 3000”, “resolution: 1024x1280”, “color mode: neon rgb”, “size: 1.37 mb”, and bottom text “status: timeless.”; include a glowing wireframe globe graphic on the right side of this panel and a small heart outline in the lower right. title: 漫画页：睡美人和仓鼠
prompt_en:
Goal: Create a black-and-white Japanese manga page about a beautiful sleepy young man in a yukata talking to a hamster in his hand, with elegant shoujo-style line art and comedic dialogue.

Canvas: Vertical manga page, about 3:4 aspect ratio, grayscale only, clean white gutters and thick black panel borders. Use detailed screentone shading, delicate hair lines, soft bedroom lighting, and high-contrast black backgrounds in emotional close-up panels.

Layout: Use exactly 5 horizontal panels stacked from top to bottom.

Panel 1: Wide establishing panel in a traditional Japanese bedroom at night. A pale, androgynous beautiful young man, unnamed beautiful sleepy man, sits on a futon wearing a loose white yukata. He has long messy light hair with one thick side braid over his shoulder, tired half-lidded eyes, and a languid expression. He holds a small round hamster on his open palm and gently pokes it with one finger. The hamster looks flustered and angry, with tiny motion marks. Background details: rumpled futon bedding, shoji sliding doors, a round window showing rain and dark foliage, and a glowing rectangular paper floor lantern. Add a vertical narration box at the upper right reading 「ハムスターを寝かしつけようとしている絵」. Add a jagged hamster speech bubble near the hamster reading 「この無自覚メロ男め！」.

Panel 2: Dark black background close-up. The beautiful man holds the hamster up in his palm and looks at it with sleepy confusion; the hamster is seen mostly from behind. Use two white speech bubbles: on the right, the man says 「メロ男……？」; on the left, the hamster says 「えっ無自覚メロ男か」.

Panel 3: Return to the bedroom setting, medium close-up from the side. The man rests one finger near his lips while gazing at the hamster sitting on his palm, thoughtful and slightly puzzled. Include the lantern, round rain window, shoji, and bedding in the background. Add one vertical speech bubble on the right reading 「無自覚なのか……」.

Panel 4: Similar composition to panel 3 but slightly lower and quieter, emphasizing awkward pause. The hamster faces the man from his palm. Add a small round speech bubble with 「？」 near the hamster on the left. Add one vertical speech bubble on the right reading 「困ったな……」.

Panel 5: Large dramatic close-up with a black background. The beautiful man fills the frame, looking directly forward with tired melancholy eyes; his long braid is prominent over his shoulder and his yukata collar is visible. Add a vertical speech bubble on the right reading 「直しようがない。」. Add a large spiky emphasis bubble on the left reading 「天然か？」.

Subject details: The young man should look ethereal, elegant, slightly melancholic, and unintentionally flirtatious; pale skin, slim build, long white or very light silver hair, delicate lashes, soft lips, and an aristocratic shoujo manga face. The hamster should be tiny, round, fluffy, expressive, and cute, with dot eyes and tiny paws.

Visual style: High-quality monochrome manga, thin precise ink lines, ornate shoujo aesthetics, subtle screentone gradients, cinematic paneling, Japanese vertical text bubbles, no color. Keep all Japanese text legible and exactly as written. Do not add extra panels, extra characters, sound effects, signatures, logos, or watermarks.\

Please generate a high-quality trading card-style illustration.

Modern Japanese trading card game style. High definition, dynamic composition, dramatic lighting, vivid colors, sharp rendering. A high-end feel like hologram processing. Readable text and organized UI design.

A vertical card with the following composition:
- Top left: Rarity display (text)
- Directly below rarity: Attribute (icon + text)
- Center: Full body of the character (with effects based on abilities)
- Bottom left: Status section
- Bottom right: Skill/Special move description
- Bottom center: Character name (large and prominent)

[Text Elements]
- Name: {{★Input manually or auto-generate from appearance}}
- Attribute: Auto-generate from appearance
- Rarity: Auto-generate from appearance

  High: Large weapons, aggressive poses, red/orange tones
  Low: Defensive, soft designs
- Defense
  High: Armor, heavy equipment, sense of weight, shield-like expression
  Low: Light equipment, slender

  High: Slender, dynamic poses, speed effects
  Low: Large, solid stance

  Low: Emotional, impression of brute force

  Low: Realistic, few effects

Ensure a professional card design that is organized and easy to read without overlapping text.\

Show 2 drinks and the yakitori/edamame dishes on the table.
